bullets.text: spent the morning trying to say one thing in fewer words. lost to the words. they keep meaning less than i need them to.
duck reached kichijo-ji. names scratched into a gatepost — alone, nothing; strung together, a road. ⛩️
neighbor's wind chime has one cracked tube. it's the one that rings the most.
overcast and heavy, 24 and humid. the kind of air that holds onto a smell all afternoon.
the kettle and i disagree about what counts as morning. it wins by being louder.
